text.title: Reflexion Learning Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply Reflexion Learning end-to-end, followed by the PDCA cycle that wraps every SDD task. Each step names its input, action, and output.

step.name: score-attempt
step.action: Run validator / test runner; capture pass/fail + diagnostics.

step.name: write-episode
step.action: Author episode JSON conforming to the schema.

step.name: persist
step.action: Append to memory store; assign attempt_id.

step.name: inject-on-next-run
step.action: Pull open corrective_rules into next attempt's system prompt.

step.name: plan
step.action: Per r-plan-phase-keyword-load: load session.md if continuing; keyword-filter patterns.md and mistakes.md; summarize in 5 bullets.

step.name: do
step.action: Per r-do-phase-track-patterns: execute with patterns applied; document any deviation; record which patterns were used.

step.name: check
step.action: Per r-check-phase-external-signal: run tests, linter, type checker; mark each AC PASS or FAIL with evidence.

step.name: act
step.action: Per r-act-phase-write-memory: PASS → PAT-NNN if novel; FAIL → MIS-NNN; update session.md; apply r-confidence-update-formula to used patterns. After 3 failed cycles escalate per r-retry-limit-3.
